boards.name: 01-figur
boards.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE 5 column x 4 row contact sheet, exactly20 distinct numbered concept panels, for the same original stylized red fox in a bright first-person educational island puzzle game. Professional 3D game asset concept studies, graceful low-poly faceted body, real quadruped anatomy, readable silhouette, russet orange fur, cream muzzle and chest, black lower legs, black nose, two narrow upright triangular ears, a single long bushy tail with white tip. A normal fox, no clothes, no humanoid gestures, no toy round bear head. Each panel contains one fox, grounded on pale sandstone, neutral sage backdrop, consistent identity. Panel1 stone fox sitting 3/4 front,2 stone side,3 stone front,4 stone back,5 stone top;6 living fox sitting front3/4,7 living side,8 living front,9 living back,10 living top;11 living standing3/4,12 standing side,13 head profile pointed muzzle,14 paws detail,15 white tail tip;16 alert ears,17 sleepy eyes,18 mouth holding a loose natural-fiber rope loop,19 gentle relieved expression,20 relaxed final seated pose. Stone version is muted warm grey sandstone with fine shallow cracks; living version exactly same geometry/proportions, no different fox. Clear small panel numbers1–20 only, no other text, no logo, no watermark, no extra animals. Clean consistent art direction with warm afternoon sunlight and soft shadows, suitable for a modeled animation prototype, high quality and precise shapes.

boards.name: 02-erwachen
boards.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE precisely20-panel storyboard contact sheet,5columns by4rows, numbered1–20, no other captions. Original first-person educational island game, same russet-orange faceted fox identity from reference image (reference is character style only, not an image to edit): cream muzzle/chest, black lower legs/nose, two pointed ears, long white-tipped tail, natural quadruped, no clothing, no humanoid hand gestures. Warm sandstone garden, soft sunlight, clear lime and orange foliage. Strong continuity, realistic physical contacts and scale, high-quality coherent3D concept renders. Show20 tightly staged keyframes of the SAME fox changing from warm grey sandstone statue in sitting pose to living orange fox. Frames1–4 wholly stone unmoving;5–8 tiny cracks and warm orange slowly returning first to face and ears;9–12 color spreads through body, eyes gradually open, ears twitch;13–16 careful neck turn, slow tail uncurls;17–20 fox rises onto four paws and looks toward a garden gate. No exploding rocks, fire, giant particles or violent fractures. Color transition without shape identity change, stone texture subtle. Exactly one fox per panel. Keep camera close side3/4 and same ground to show paws planted while waking.

boards.name: 04-seil-und-tor
boards.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE precisely20-panel storyboard contact sheet,5columns by4rows, numbered1–20, no other captions. Original first-person educational island game, same russet-orange faceted fox identity from reference image (reference is character style only, not an image to edit): cream muzzle/chest, black lower legs/nose, two pointed ears, long white-tipped tail, natural quadruped, no clothing, no humanoid hand gestures. Warm sandstone garden, soft sunlight, clear lime and orange foliage. Strong continuity, realistic physical contacts and scale, high-quality coherent3D concept renders. Twenty clear mechanical interaction vignettes showing SAME fox releasing a child-friendly wooden garden gate. Physically precise small mechanism: a simple low horizontal wooden sliding latch on gate, held closed by a removable natural-fiber cord loop, loose rope end hangs at fox muzzle height. Sequence panels1–4 closed gate, loop retains latch;5–8 fox walks up and sniffs loop;9–12 muzzle and teeth grip the loose loop, no arms;13–16 fox gently steps backwards pulling rope, latch slides horizontally clear of its keeper;17–18 freed gate swings away from the fox;19–20 fox sits safely beside open doorway. Interleave wide and close views so rope routing, mouth contact, latch release and clearance are unambiguous. No chain, no lock/key, no magical opening, no injury.
